purpose: Offline Unity renderer/object/triangle attribution only; never an actor input.
rendererImplementation: UltrasoundManager.Scan Physics.RaycastAll; first entering Shadow object emits bright edge and terminates the beam.
sampling: Three deterministic ray slabs at local z = -0.5*thickness, 0, +0.5*thickness; original capture used stochastic per-beam z and cannot be replayed bit-exactly without saved RNG state.
combinedSkeletonLimitation: All ribs and vertebrae are one GameObject/mesh named Skeleton; triangle identity proves bone-mesh contribution but does not provide a rib/lamina/transverse-process semantic label.

classificationRule.VERIFIED_ANATOMICAL_LANDMARK: Requires repeatable object/triangle attribution plus a simulator semantic object identity for the named landmark.
classificationRule.GENERIC_VISUAL_FEATURE: Repeatable renderer feature attributable only to broad tissue/shadow/window behavior, not a unique named landmark.
classificationRule.AMBIGUOUS: Multiple physical structures or level-dependent sources produce the prototype, or the combined mesh prevents semantic attribution.
